title: Capture a crash report inside a failing process
goal: Configure Unix CoreCLR crash evidence before startup when an external createdump process is unsuitable, and distinguish report-only capture from memory dumps.

selectionNotes: Unix CoreCLR reporter; Windows, NativeAOT and mobile deployment are excluded. Reports contain sensitive diagnostics and need writable private storage.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The described runtime capability or baseline changes in .NET 11.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build net11.0 references; the exact RC2 SDK is an evidence baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no preview language syntax is needed.

packageAssets: Framework references and runtime assemblies; no external NuGet package.
providers: CoreCLR in-process reporter; older comparison uses createdump.
platforms: Linux x64 executed; macOS source-reviewed, not executed. Windows does not use this Unix path.
prerequisites: Console project with net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable and implicit usings enabled. Complete source and usage are bundled below.
constraints: Unix CoreCLR reporter; Windows, NativeAOT and mobile deployment are excluded. Reports contain sensitive diagnostics and need writable private storage.
stabilityLimitations: Verified on RC2 artifacts; reconcile final .NET 11 GA contracts before release.

evidence.scope: Actual Linux x64 child FailFast under each pinned SDK/runtime; report includes the original DispatchFailure frame. .NET 10 createdump versus .NET 11 in-process report. No production, Apple, mobile or NativeAOT execution.
